build_autoencoder_tiny_model: build an AutoencoderTiny model with custom encoder and decoder block channel configurations
encode_images_to_latents: encode a batch of images into compressed latent representations using the AutoencoderTiny encoder
decode_latents_to_images: decode latent representations back into images using the AutoencoderTiny decoder
run_tiled_encoding: run tiled encoding on large images to keep memory usage constant regardless of image size
scale_and_unscale_latents: scale latents to 0-1 range and unscale them back to their original range
